Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters necessary for the composition and operation of the Committee of Recommendation of Supreme Court Justice Candidates (hereinafter referred to as the "Recommendation Committee") pursuant to Article 41-2 (9) of the Court Organization Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act").
